kpis.description_fr: Climate Solutions Americas = HVAC résidentiel + commercial USA. Plus gros segment Carrier. Réglementation refrigerant (A2L) drives renewal.
kpis.description_en: Climate Solutions Americas = US residential + commercial HVAC. Carrier's largest segment. Refrigerant regulation (A2L) drives renewal.

kpis.description_fr: Climate Solutions Europe = nouveau segment post-acquisition Viessmann Climate Solutions (clôture jan 2024 pour 13 Mds €). Heat pumps Europe.
kpis.description_en: Climate Solutions Europe = new segment post Viessmann Climate Solutions acquisition (closed Jan 2024 for €13B). Europe heat pumps.

kpis.name_fr: Pompes à chaleur (% du CA Climate)

kpis.description_en: Heat pumps mix (vs gas boilers) jumps thanks to electrification + Viessmann. Long-term: structural climate transition.

kpis.description_fr: Backlog ~6 Mds $, surtout commercial HVAC + data center cooling. Data center cooling = nouveau driver fort 2024-25.
kpis.description_en: Backlog ~$6B, mainly commercial HVAC + data center cooling. Data center cooling = strong new 2024-25 driver.

kpis.description_fr: Aftermarket = pièces, maintenance, contrats long-terme. Marges élevées récurrentes. Cible 30 % d'ici 2028.
kpis.description_en: Aftermarket = parts, maintenance, long-term service contracts. Recurring high margins. Targeting 30% by 2028.
